Targ. Y. Deut. II, 31.

notas_originais: Sabb. 91 b או' ed. (Ms. M. אב'; Ar. ארנסי). [As to ור, בר for aspirate r, v. Lidd. a. Scott, Gr. Lex, 7 th ed. s. lit. P.]

definicoes_originais: (ארע; corresp. to h. צִרְעָה) wasp, hornet (collect.).
notas_originais: Targ. Y. Ex. XXIII, 28; a. e.— Pl. אוּרְעַיָּיתָא. Targ. Y. Deut. I, 44; a. e.—אוּרְעֵי, אוּרְעַיָּה. Targ. Y. Lev. XI, 20 ed. pr. (corr. vowel signs; later ed. אוזפיה). Y. Sabb. I, 3 b bot. תולעתא דסוסיא וכ' the mite in the horse’s carcass turns into hornets. [Cmp. same ideas among the Greek, Sachs Beitr. II, 92; Nican Ther. 741.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: tarde; noite; anoitecer. Jastrow observa a acepção noturna da palavra empregada na tradição mishnaica.
notas_originais: Pes. 2 ab אור א' the or of the Mishn. means evening. Ber. 3 b; a. fr.—Y. Sot. I, 17 b top, v. בְּרַת.

verbetes.glosa_atual: soprar fortemente; produzir ruído; gritar. Em outra acepção, inchar, aumentar ou tornar-se prolixo.
definicoes_originais: to blow vehemently, make noise, shout.
to swell, to be large, fulsome, lengthy (in wording).
notas_originais: אַוֵּושׁ, (√אוו, v. אָוָוז; cmp. אוף, אנף, אפף, אופי, אוסי, אבב)

B. Mets. 86 a נשב זיקא וא' וכ' the wind blew and howled between the branches. Ber. 50 a וכ' איידי דאוושו because all shouted, the prayer was not heard. Ib. אוושו כ"ע ברכו they all shouted ‘bar’khu’.—Erub. 97 b אוושא מילתא the thing grows loud, becomes known. Ḥull. 46 b ריאה דא' lungs which give out a sound when blown up (indicating perforation). Ber. 58 a כי קא אוושא (Ms. M. שמעו קל א') when shouting was heard.

R. Hash. 35 a משום דאוושי ברכות (Ms. M. קראי …) because the benedictions are numerous and lengthy. Ned. 2 b הלין דא' וכ' משום because the last named propositions are lengthy, he explained first what he had commenced with.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ser forte; existir; firmar-se. Em forma reflexiva ou passiva, ser confirmado ou consolidar-se.
definicoes_originais: (v. foreg; cmp. יֵשׁ, אִישׁ) to be strong, exist.
notas_originais: Nithpol. נִתְאֹושֵׁשׁ to be confirmed. Gen. R. s. 67; s. 78 והיכן נ' בידן when were the blessings made sure &c. Cmp. אָשַׁשׁ.

verbetes.glosa_atual: fundamentos; alicerces; estruturas de sustentação, especialmente de paredes.
notas_originais: B. Kam. 50 a חופר לא' digs excavations for supporting walls.

verbetes.glosa_atual: fundação; alicerce; estrutura de base; também fortificação.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Usha; localidade na Galileia associada a assembleias e decretos rabínicos.
definicoes_originais: Uhsa, in Galilee; freq. the scene of rabbin.
notas_originais: synods and enactments during and after the Hadrianic persecutions. Keth. 50 a מרה דשמעתא דא' master of the traditions of U. (in whose name they are quoted). [Ib. קאי באוכלוסא דא', read בהילכתא engaged in teaching the laws passed at U.] R. Hash. 31 b; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: pousada; hospedaria; alojamento de pernoite; plural אוּשְׁפִּיזִין.
definicoes_originais: (נשף, with ז format; cmp. אטליז) night’s lodging, inn.
notas_originais: — Pl. אוּשְׁפִּיזִין. בעלי א' innkeepers. Tosef. Maas. Sh. I, 13; Meg. 26 a. [Mand. שפינזא, v. Nœld. Mand. Gr. p. 51.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: hospedaria; alojamento temporário; hospedagem em contraste com residência permanente.
notas_originais: Git. 44 b אית ליה א' וכ' he has a lodging place in Palestine, (is an occasional resident), opp. ביתא permanent home. Meg. 26 a; Yoma 12 a it is customary to leave empty jars and hides of slaughtered animals (ל) באושפיזֵיה in one’s inn. Zeb. 61 b א' הוה נקט וכ' (Ms. M. אוּשְׁפְּזִיכָא … נקיטא, v. אושפיזכן; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) the Divine fire took up its abode now here and now there. Erub. 53 b שאיל בא' (Rashi משייל בעניין אושפזיכני, read ניה …, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 80) inquired after the character of an inn (of his landlord). Ib. (enigmatic inquiry that the landlord might not overhear it) גבר פום דין חי מה טיבו Ar. (v. Rabb. l. c. note 90) = איש־פי־ז־נא our inn—what is its character?

verbetes.glosa_atual: estalajadeiro; hospedeiro; proprietário da pousada; anfitrião.
notas_originais: ך, cmp. דָּא, דֵּךְ) innkeeper, landlord, host. Meg. 26 a; Yoma 12 a; Sot. 37 a; Zeb. 54 a נעשה א' וכ' Benjamin became the host of the Divine Presence (the Temple being partly situated in his territory).

verbetes.glosa_atual: hospedeiro; anfitrião; forma aramaica. Feminino אוּשְׁפִּיזַכְתָּא, anfitriã.
notas_originais: Zeb. 18 b בר אושפיזכניה (Ms. M. only אוּשְׁפְּזִיכְנֵיה) (the son of) his host. Snh. 7 b bot. Yoma 78 a פיזכנה … Ms. M. (ed. נין …). Bets. 4 a; a. fr.—Erub. 53 b, v. אוּשְׁפִּיזָא.—Fem. אוּשְׁפִּיזַכְתָּא hostess. Ber. 18 b ed. Ms. M. (בת אושפיזכניה).

verbetes.glosa_atual: unir; juntar; ajustar ou harmonizar. Na forma passiva ou reflexiva, agradar, convir, ficar satisfeito ou deleitar-se.
definicoes_originais: (b. h.) to be suited, pleased, whence to be gratified, to enjoy.
notas_originais: Y. Ber. III, 6 c top ראה את עצמו נ' וכ' he dreamt he felt sexual gratification; Y. Yoma VII, 44 d bot.; Y. Taan. I, 64 c bot.—Y. Bets. I, 61 a כל שנֵאותין בו בי"ט whatever you are permitted to make use of on Holy Days.— Fut. יֵאוֹת. Ber. VIII, 6 עד שיֵאוֹתוּ לאורו until being near enough to enjoy its light. Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39 c top, a. e., differences as to spelling יֵאוֹתוּ or יֵעוּתוּ.—Denom. הֲנָאָה, נָאֶה, נָאוֶה, נוֹי.

verbetes.glosa_atual: marca; sinal; emblema; prova ou insígnia militar. Também letra, caractere da escrita ou símbolo.
definicoes_originais: c. (b. h.; v. אוי, אָוָה II; תְּאָו)
mark, sign, emblem; test, signal, military ensign.
notas_originais: Ḥag. 16 a (play on ואתה Deut. XXXIII, 2; cmp. foreg.) אות הוא וכ' He is the ensign among his myriad; v. דּוּגְמָא. M. Kat. 25 b אל תזניחנו בא' וכ' forsake us not in the symbolic trial of bitter waters (in our trials). Pl. אוֹתוֹת. Kil. IX, 10 א' הגרדין וכ' the marks which the weavers &c. put on goods in their charge. B. Kam. 119 b you must not buy from the dyer לא א' ולא דוגמות either tests (pieces cut off to test the color) or samples (as specimens of color).

B. Bath. 15 a אות אחת one letter. Sabb. 103 a; a. fr.— Pl. אוֹתִיּוֹת (fr. אוֹתוּת or אוֹתִית). Kid. 30 a סופרים כל הא' recorded (or counted) all the letters of the Torah. Snh. X, 1 השם באוֹתִיוֹתָיו the Divine Name with the letters in which it is written (Jehovah). Kid. 71 a שם בן ארבע א' the quadriliteral Name; cmp. שֵׁם.—Lev. R. s. 26, beg. ח' א' eight letters. Sabb. XII. 3; a. fr.—Trnsf. notes, documents. Tosef. Kid. I, 7; B. Bath. 75 b; a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: partícula que introduz complemento direto, especialmente com sufixos pronominais; também reforça o sujeito ou identifica alguém como o próprio.
definicoes_originais: v. אֵת) only with pronominal suffix
indicating the objective case, אוֹתִי me, אוֹתְךָ thee, &c.—2) with pronom.
with pronom. suffix of third person, for emphasizing the subject, אוֹתוֹ he himself, this one, the same, he who &c. Gen. R. s. 2, beg. ישב לו א' וכ' the latter now sat there confounded &c. Y. Git.
notas_originais: VI, 47 d באותו ענין on this very subject (divorce). Sabb. 13 b זכור אותו האיש וכ' may that man be remembered for good. Ber. V, 3 באוֹתָהּ שעה in that hour; a. fr.—אותו מקום euphem. for pudenda. Nid. 47 b. Git. 69 b; a. e.—אותו ואת בנו the law concerning the killing of the young with its mother on the same day (Lev. XXII, 28). Ḥull. V, 1; a. fr.— Pl. אוֹתָן. Y. Meg. IV, 74 d top א' שבפה those laws delivered orally. Keth. 4 a כל א' הימים all those days; a. fr. [In later writings אותו האיש is freq. used for Jesus of Nazareth.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ser cortado ou separado; afastar-se; partir; ir embora; divergir de entendimento.
definicoes_originais: (= אזז √אז; cmp. אזל I; גז, חז, עז, חצד &c.) to be cut off; to go apart, be gone.
notas_originais: Sabb. 34 b; a. fr. ואזדו לטעמייהו they differ (cmp. פלג), each following his own principle (or consistent with opinions elsewhere expressed). Ned. 41 a שיתא אזדו (Rashi אזלו ליה) six of them are gone (escaped his memory). Bets. 10 b אזדו לעלמא disappeared (Ms. M. אזלו; 11 a אזלו). Meïl. 17 b נפק אזדא Ar. (read אזד, ed. אזל) he went out and away. V. אֲזַל.

verbetes.glosa_atual: decreto; decisão determinada; aquilo que foi decretado. Em Daniel 2.5 pode apresentar a ideia de ordem firmada.
notas_originais: Dan. II, 5.—B. Mets. 116 b if the landlord said, I let you this loft (as it is) א' it is a (divine) decree, i.e. it is the tenant’s misfortune that the loft fell in, and he has no claims. V. Ges. H. Dict. s. v.

verbetes.glosa_atual: advertência prévia; proibição legal, sobretudo vedação expressa das Escrituras; também esclarecimento ou iluminação.
definicoes_originais: forewarning, prohibition, esp. the explicit prohibition (‘ thou shalt not’) in the Bible, required for punishing trespassers.
notas_originais: Y. Peah I, 16 a top א' ללה"ר a biblical admonition against calumny. Num. R. s. 7 (play on zara Num. XI, 20) והי' לכם לא' it shall be a warning to you. Yeb. 3 b א' שמענו וכ' we learn here the legal prohibition, whence do we derive the penalty? a. tr.— Pl. אַזְהָרֹות. Kerith. III, 10; a. fr.
Cant. R. to VII, 3, v. אִדַּר.

verbetes.glosa_atual: advertência ou proibição legal; equivalente à primeira acepção de אַזְהָרָה.
notas_originais: Shebu. 20 b ואַזְהַרְתֵּיה מה' and the legal prohibition concerning it, is to be derived from this verse.— Pl. אַזְהָרָן. Y. Yoma VIII, 45 a תלת א' three prohibitory verses.

verbetes.glosa_atual: hissopo; nome botânico tradicional, também em expressão hissopo grego; a identificação exata pode variar conforme a tradição.
notas_originais: Neg. XIV, 6 א' יון (Ar. אזביון) Greek hyssop. Sabb. XIV, 3 (109 b) איזוביון, איזביון (read two words, Ms. O., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 4); a. fr.— Pl. אֵיזֹובִים M. Kat. 25 b אֵיזֹובֵי קִיר the hyssop (moss) on the wall (common humanity); v. אֶרֶז.

verbetes.glosa_atual: hissopo; equivalente aramaico de אֵזֹוב.
notas_originais: Targ. Ex. XII, 22; a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: cinto; faixa; cinturão.
notas_originais: M. Kat. 14 a אֵיזֹורֹו וכ' his girdle (around his house-gown) testifies for him (that he has no more than the shirt he is washing). Tosef. Shebu. V, 12 sq.; a. e.— Pl. אֵזֹורִים, אֵיז'. Gen. R. s. 100 אֵזוֹרֵי מתניהם וכ' they loosened the girdles of their loins (in mourning sympathy). [Ch. זריז.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: cinto; faixa; correspondente aramaico de אֵזֹור; plural e variantes registradas.
notas_originais: Sot. I, 17 b top איזורִי ואיזורֵיה דברי וכ' my belt, and my son’s belt and that of his father in law; Num. R. s. 9 (p. 232 b ed. Amst.); Y. Peah VII, 20 a bot. (corr. acc.); cmp. Midr. Sam. ch. XIII.

verbetes.glosa_atual: aquecer; produzir calor ou vapor. Na construção passiva, ser aquecido; especialmente em passagens sobre fornalha.
definicoes_originais: (= אַזְעִי, v. אוּדְיָיתָא a. זִיעַ) to heat ( make steam).
notas_originais: Dan. III, 19; 22.—Targ. Is. XXXIII, 4 וַאֲזַן (Regia אֵיזִין) and they shall heat (baths, ovens) therewith (h. text מַשַּׂק = מַשַּׁק), v. זִירְקְתָא; (cmp. Ezek. XXXIX, 9). Ib. XLIV, 15 (for baking); a. e.—Y. Ter. VIII, end, 46 c a bath house דאזייה וכ' which he had heated for seven days. Koh. R. to II, 8; a. e. דהוון אָזְיִין בהון that entertained the fires in them.—Lev. R. s. 28, end ועל מזגיה וקנחיה (read ואַזְּיֵיה Pa.) and he (Haman) went and made him sweat and cleansed him (with the scraper).
Gen. R. s. 63 קלוון אנא דיִתְּזוּן וכ' I command that the bath-houses be heated. Ib. אזלון ואִתְּזוּן they went off, and the bath-houses were heated (some ed. דְּיִחֲמוּן a. אַחְמוּן).

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אֲזַל; remissão.
notas_originais: , v. אֲזַל

verbetes.glosa_atual: armas; armamento. A expressão בית אֲזֵינָא designa depósito de armas ou aljava.
definicoes_originais: , pl. (זין) אֲזֵינִין weapons, בית א' receptacle of weapons, quiver.
notas_originais: Targ. Jer. V, 16. Targ. Is. XLIX, 2 (ed. Ven. אַזְנִין). V. Targ. to Deut. XXIII, 14 אֲזֵנֶךָ.

verbetes.glosa_atual: amarrar; atar; prender; na forma causativa, ligar ou envolver.
definicoes_originais: (Af. of אזק, v. חזק, עזק) to tie up.
notas_originais: Koh. R. to VIII, 1 א' לרישי I have to tie up my head. (Yalk. Koh. 977 דחיק, Vers. אדיק; Y. Pes. X, 37 c חזיק רישיה his head was tied; cmp. Ned. 49 b.)

verbetes.glosa_atual: lembrança; menção; recitação de oração; menção do Nome Divino. Também o Tetragrama, designação do Nome de Deus.
definicoes_originais: remembrance, mention (of Div. Name), recitation (of prayer); reference.
notas_originais: Y. Ber. V, 9 b א' שהיא מריוח the reference to rain (in the second section of the eighteen benedictions) which is an expression of satisfaction (plenty), opp. שאלה, the prayer for rain (in the ninth benediction) which is an expression of anxiety.—Y. Meg. III, 74 b top שתהא אַזְכָּרָתָן קודם וכ' that the recitation (of the events commemorated on Purim) precede the celebration thereof.

Num. R. s. 2, beg. the students מראים את הא' וכ' point out the Div. Name with their fingers; Cant. R. to II, 4 מדלג על הא' skips the Div. Name in recitation of lessons.— Pl. אַזְכָּרֹות. Yoma 8 a שיש בהן א' הרבה in which the Div. N. frequently occurs. Y. Ber. III, 6 c.—Y. Sabb. XVI, 15 c bot.; Bab. ibid. 116 a קודר אזכרותֵיהֶן you must cut out the Div. N. occurring in them (the heretic writings). Y. Taan. II, 65 c top י"ח א' וכ' eighteen times that the Tetragrammaton appears in the Psalm Habu (XXIX). Num. R. s. 2, beg.; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ir; sair; partir; afastar-se; caminhar. Verbo aramaico com imperativo אִיזֵּיל.
definicoes_originais: to be gone, to leave; to go.
notas_originais: Targ. Gen. XXXII, 1. Imper. אִיזֵּיל, אִזֵּיל. Targ. O. Num. XXII, 20; a. fr.—Y. Snh. X, 28 b איזיל חמי וכ' go, show thy face &c. Ib. לינה מֵיזַל … דנא מיזל וכ' I will not go … for if I did go &c. Sabb. 116 a א' כתב א' וכ' after the writing is gone, the sacredness of the scroll is gone (after the scroll has become unfit for sacred use, the material has lost its sacred character). Y. Dem. III, 23 b bot. הא אזילא מיבלא וכ' that man’s load would soon be gone (if each were permitted to take a chip). Y. Ber. VIII, 12 a הא אזילא ההיא דרב וכ' is the decision of Rab and Samuel gone (to be disregarded)? Y. Snh. X, 28 a bot. הא א' הדא וכ' (ed. Krot. חדא) is that which was received from (is the tradition of) … to be disregarded? Y. Yeb. VIII, 9 c bot. הא אזילא היא וכ' (ed. Krot. איזלא, corr. acc.; for היא read הדא or ההיא).—Trnsf. to depart life, die. Y. Ḥag. II, 77 d bot. this one committed a sin וא' בה and died in it, and the other &c. M. Kat. 28 b ווי לאזלא woe, for the departed one! Y. Keth. XII, 35 a top אזיל to die, contrad. to אתי to resurrect.—Imperat. usu. זִיל = אזיל.—Ḥull. 11 b ז' בתר רובא follow the majority of cases; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: fiar; tecer. Homógrafo verbal distinto do verbo que significa ir ou partir.
notas_originais: XXVII, 19; √זל) to spin, weave. B. Mets. 24 b קיבורא דאזלי ביה אזלויי a skein which the net-weavers had used; v. זוּל II. Denom. אִיזְלָא a. next w.

verbetes.glosa_atual: tecelão; pessoa que fia ou tece; plural אַזְלֹויֵי.
notas_originais: Pl. אַזְלֹויֵי. B. Mets. 24 b (some ed. אזלוי corr. acc.), v. foreg.

verbetes.glosa_atual: águas correntes; correntezas; ondas, no plural.
notas_originais: Targ. O. Ex. XV, 8 (Var. אָזְלַיָּא; Y. נָזְלַיָּא).

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אִיזְמָא; remissão.
notas_originais: , v. אִיזְמָא

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אִזְמַרְגַּד; remissão.
notas_originais: , v. אִזְמַרְגַּד

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אִיזְמֵל; remissão.
notas_originais: , v. אִיזְמֵל

verbetes.glosa_atual: esmeralda; pedra preciosa verde; também cristal colorido, segundo a nomenclatura da fonte; do grego σμάραγδος.
definicoes_originais: (σμάραγδος, σμαράγδιον) emerald, a jewel (also colored crystal; v. זמרגד a. זמרגדין).
notas_originais: Targ. Job. XLII, 13. Targ. O. Ex. XXVIII, 18 (Targ. Y. ib. אִזְמֹורַד); a. e. Ex. R. s. 38, end אִסְמַרַגְדִּין.

verbetes.glosa_atual: terceira pessoa do plural de אֲזָא, em Isaías 33.4 no Targum; ver אֲזִי.
notas_originais: Targ. Is. XXXIII, 4, third pers. pl. of אֲזָא, v. אֲזִי

verbetes.glosa_atual: orelha; ouvido; alça de recipiente; por extensão, gânglios inchados na garganta, em expressão específica.
definicoes_originais: to be pointed, cut, cmp. חז, גז.
אָזְנַיִם or בנות א' swollen glands of the throat (Rashi).
notas_originais: v. אוּדְנָא)
B. Kam. 79 b א' של מַטָּה human ear, opp. Divine perception. Y. Sabb. I, 3 b top; a. fr.

Cant. R. beg. ולא הי' לה א' וכ' but had no handle and could not be carried; a. fr.— Du. אָזְנַיִם 1) ears. Lev. R. s. 32, beg. א' לדרך the road has ears (be on your guard in speaking); a. fr.—2) handles. Kel. IV, 3, v. גיסטרא; a. fr.
Ab. Zar. 28 b א'; Y. ib. II, 40 d top; Y. Sabb. XIV, 14 d top בנות א'.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אוּזְנִיּוֹת; remissão.
notas_originais: , v. אוּזְנִיּוֹת

verbetes.glosa_atual: cingir; colocar à volta; fortalecer; na construção reflexiva, cingir-se e tomar força.
definicoes_originais: to put around, girdle; to strengthen.
notas_originais: Ber. 16 b ותִתְאַזָּר וכ' and gird thyself with thy mercy.

verbetes.glosa_atual: nativo; natural do país; cidadão; literalmente, pessoa estabelecida ou plantada na terra.
notas_originais: Succ. 28 a א' זה א' if it read ezra ḥ (Lev. XXIII, 42), it would mean every native (man or woman); a. fr.— Pl. אֶזְרָחִים. Sifra Emor, end.—Fem. אֶזְרָחִית, pl. אֶזְרָחִיּות. Succ. l. c.

verbetes.glosa_atual: braço; membro superior; correspondente aramaico do hebraico זְרֹועַ.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. II. Num. XXXI, 50; v. זְרֹועַ.

verbetes.glosa_atual: peça de fixação; alça; apêndice para segurar; plural אִזְתַּוְודֵּי.
notas_originais: Pl. אִזְתַּוְודֵּי. Targ. Y. Ex. XXV, 12 ed. Vien. (oth. ed. אזתוור'; ib. XXXVII, 3 אסתוור', v. Ibn Ezra comment. a. l.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: irmão; parente; companheiro; igual ou correligionário. Plurais אַחִים e אַחִין.
definicoes_originais: brother, kinsman; fellow, equal, fellow-believer &c. Meg. 11 a (play on ăhashverosh, Ahasverus) אָׄחִׄיו ש̇ל ר̇אש̇ וכ' a brother (in cruelty) to the chief tyrant (Nebucadn.); a. fr.— Pl. אַחִים, אַחִין.
notas_originais: Gen. R. s. 89, beg. (play on ā ḥ u, Gen. XLI, 2) in years of plenty הבריות נעשו א' וכ' people are brotherly to each other. Ib. s. 99 אחים דפחתא וכ' brothers to the degraded woman (Dinah), … but not to Joseph; a. fr.—Cant. R. to VIII, 1 שני אחים brother and sister

verbetes.glosa_atual: irmão; correspondente aramaico de אָח, com variantes אַחָא e אָחָא; plural אָחִין.
notas_originais: Targ. fr.— Pl. אָחִין. Targ. Gen. XIII, 8; a. e.—אַחֵי Yeb. 65 b.—Y. Yoma VI, 43 d אֲחֵינָן our brothers

verbetes.glosa_atual: ai!; ah!; interjeição de dor, pesar ou lamentação. Homógrafo distinto da palavra irmão.
definicoes_originais: (b. h.) exclamation of sorrow, Oh! Meg. 11 a (play on ăhashverosh; v. אָח I) א' לראשו woe upon his head.
notas_originais: interj.
Snh. 102 b (play on Ahab אח־אב) א' לשמי' a subject of grief to the Lord, and father (friend) of idolatry.—2 (= Syr.) exclamation of joy, Ah! Targ. Is. XLIV, 16 (h. הֶאָח).

verbetes.glosa_atual: Aha; nome próprio masculino de um sábio rabínico; também aparece no sentido comum de irmão.
definicoes_originais: pr. n. m. A ḥ a.
notas_originais: Arakh. 22 b; Keth. 88 a, surnamed שר הבירה superintendent of the palace. Y. Ber. II, 5 a R. A. surnamed Roba; a. many others. Y. Taan. II, 65 a bot.; a. v. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Ahai; nome próprio masculino registrado em Ḥullin 59b.
notas_originais: Ḥull. 59 b

verbetes.glosa_atual: tio paterno; irmão do pai; forma contraída de expressão aramaica.
definicoes_originais: (contr. of אחי אבא) father’s brother, uncle.
notas_originais: Targ. Jer. XXXII, 7 אַחֲבוּךְ thy uncle. Targ. O. Lev. X, 4 (Ms. I a. III אח אבוהי; Targ. Y. חביבא q. v.); a. e. Yeb. 21 b Ar. s. v. בי אחבא (ed. בי דודי).

verbetes.glosa_atual: um; uma; único; singular. Em sentido ampliado, unido ou cerrado; misterioso, conforme a fonte.
definicoes_originais: , אַחַת f. (b. h.; v. next w., a. חַד) one.
notas_originais: [Freq. represented by א'.] Kid. 50 b, a. fr. בבת אחת simultaneously, v. בַּת III. Peah III, 3 המחליק מאחת יד וכ' (Ms. M. בא') he who takes out onions with a unity of hand, i.e. all of them for one purpose. Ber. 61 b, a. fr. על אחת כמה וכמה (abbr. עאכ"ו) how much against one, i.e. how much the more.—אחד … אחד both … as well as. Tem. I, 1 א' האנשים וכ' both, men as well as women. Y. Keth. V, 29 d top אחת זו ואחתֹ זו the one as well as the other; a. fr.—כְּאֶחָד, כְּאַחַת at the same time. Tosef. Neg. I, 11; sq. Sot. 8 a; a. fr.—Yoma I, 7 והפג אחת and cool thyself for once, for a change, v. חֲדַת.— Pl. אֲחָדִים
Yalk. Gen. 62 (ref. to דברים אחדים Gen. XI, 1) they spoke words על שני א' against two only ones (ref. to אחד Ezek. XXXIII, 24 a. Deut. VI, 4) [corr. acc. Gen. R. s. 38].
Gen. R. l. c. (Yalk. l. c. אֲחוּדִים v. next w.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: reunir; juntar; fechar; unir. Particípio passivo relacionado a fechado, unido ou misterioso.
definicoes_originais: (sec. r. of חוּד, v. חוּד I) to join, close.
notas_originais: Part. pass. אָחוּד, pl. אֲחוּדִים
. Yalk. Gen. 62, v. foreg.
Gen. R. s. 38 (ref. to Gen. XI, 1, v. foreg.) דברים א' common goods, communism.

verbetes.glosa_atual: fechar; trancar; apreender; capturar; dedicar. Na construção passiva, ser preso, fechado ou unido.
definicoes_originais: (corresp. to h. סגר a. תפש; cmp. h. אחז) to close (the door), to lock up; to seize, capture.
notas_originais: אָחֵיד, אַחֵד ch. (v. foreg.)

Targ. Is. XXII, 22 אָחֵיד. Ib. יֵיחֹוד, יִיחֹוד (fut.).—Targ. Deut. XXI, 19 יְאַ' = יַחֲדוּן (Pa.; Var. יֶחֱדוּן = יֶאֶח' Pe.). Targ. Am. III, 5; a. fr.—Snh. 26 a bot., a. e. אחדיה לדשא locked the door. Pes. 111 b ליה רוחא אחדא a spirit (demon, disease) seizes him.— Part. pass. אֲחִיד a) locked up. Targ. Josh. VI, 1; a. e.—b) (v. אָחוּז, s. v. אָחַז) holding. Targ. Am. II, 15; a. fr.— Part. pass. Pa. מְאַחַד locked up, hidden. Targ. Job. XXVI, 9.
Targ. Ps. LXXIII, 23.
. Targ. Ez. XIX, 4; a. fr.
Targ. Is. XXIV, 10 את אחידו … (read אתאחידו). Ib. LIX, 10 Rashi (ed. אתא חד corr. acc.). Targ. Job XLI, 9 (8); a. e.—אִתְּחִיד. Ḥull. 52 b א' דשא the door was locked.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ferrolho; tranca; ato de fechar. Em expressão figurada, fechamento do útero.
notas_originais: Targ. Prov. XVIII, 19 (read … היך א' ד).
אֵחֲדַת רחמי shutting up of the womb, barrenness. Ibid. XXX, 16.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Ahadboy; nome próprio masculino de um amora.
definicoes_originais: (contr. of אח־דאבא; v. אחבא) pr. n. m. A ḥ adboy, an Amora.
notas_originais: Ḥull. 113 b; a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אחי; remissão.
notas_originais: , v. אחי
